note: A1 vocabulary in teaching order, keyed to data/curriculum-a1.json. Every noun carries its article and plural, and every word an example sentence. A1.1 (units 1-20) written; A1.2 (21-40) to follow.

words.example_de: Guten Tag! Wie geht es Ihnen?

words.example_en: Excuse me, where is the station?

words.example_de: Der erste Buchstabe ist ein A.
words.example_en: The first letter is an A.

words.example_de: Ä, ö und ü sind Umlaute.
words.example_en: Ä, ö and ü are umlauts.
Straße is written with an ß.
Nouns are written with a capital.
Verbs are written in lower case.

words.example_de: Wir sind zu dritt — drei Personen.

words.en: girl — -chen is always das, whatever the person
teacher (m) — -er doing a job is usually der

words.example_en: The teacher is called Mrs Kaya.

words.example_de: Dreißig Minuten sind eine halbe Stunde.
words.example_en: Thirty minutes is half an hour.
A hundred grams of cheese, please.

words.en: half — halb drei is half past TWO, not three

words.example_en: The shops are shut on Sunday.

words.en: tomorrow — lower case; der Morgen is the morning
to work — stem ends in -t, so du arbeitest
to eat — strong: du isst, er isst
words.example_en: What do you like to eat?

words.en: to travel / drive — strong: du fährst
parents — plural only, there is no singular

words.example_de: Ihr Sohn ist sechs Jahre alt.
words.example_en: Her son is six years old.

words.en: his — same word as the verb sein, told apart by position
flower — -n, which almost every die word takes

words.example_de: Das Bild ist von meiner Tochter.
words.example_en: The picture is by my daughter.

words.example_de: Meine Sachen sind in der Tasche.
words.example_en: My things are in the bag.
A hundred grams of cheese, please.
The butter is in the fridge.

words.example_de: Ich kaufe Obst auf dem Markt.
words.example_en: I buy fruit at the market.

words.en: would like — the politest thing you can say
together — as in paying for all of it
separately — the other answer to that question
not — negates verbs, adjectives, everything but a noun
no / not a — the one that negates a noun

words.example_de: Ich möchte gehen, aber ich bin müde.
words.example_en: I want to go, but I'm tired.

words.en: yes it is — contradicts a negative question
words.example_en: Aren't you coming? — Yes I am!
How many children do you have?

words.en: to repeat — the verb that rescues a conversation

words.example_en: Sometimes I read in the evening.
